+**Corollary 4.2 (Every positive resistance level and every optimizer).**
+For every integer pair $4\le a\le b$ and every real $R_0>0$, the level set
+
+$$
+\mathcal F_{a,b,R_0}
+=\{c\in(0,\infty)^{ab}:R(c)=R_0\}
+$$
+
+is nonempty and has the finite attained optimum
+
+$$
+\max_{c\in\mathcal F_{a,b,R_0}}\lambda_2(L(c))=\frac{M_{a,b}}{R_0}.
+\tag{4.9}
+$$
+
+Its labelled optimizers are exactly (4.2) with
+$\tau=M_{a,b}/R_0$. There are exactly $a$ such assignments when $a<b$.
+For $a=b=k$ there is exactly one, with every edge conductance
+$(4k-3)/R_0$.
+
+*Proof.* Theorem 4.1 bounds $\lambda_2R_0$ by $M_{a,b}$ at every
+feasible point. Take $\tau=M_{a,b}/R_0>0$ in its equality assignment.
+All edges have finite strictly positive conductance, and that theorem
+gives $R=M_{a,b}/\tau=R_0$ and $\lambda_2=\tau$. This proves both
+nonemptiness and attained finiteness inside the stated domain.
+Any optimizer must attain product equality, so Theorem 4.1 gives its
+labelled ray; the identity $R=M_{a,b}/\tau$ fixes the scale uniquely.
+In the balanced case $\tau/k=k(4k-3)/(kR_0)=(4k-3)/R_0$.
+The label counts follow from the distinct-ray classification. ∎
+

+**定义 1.1（带标号的正电导环）。** 令 $V=\mathbb Z/12\mathbb Z$，
+$e_i=\{i,i+1\}$，$E=\{e_i:i\in V\}$，所得简单图记为 $C_{12}$。
+各边电导 $c_i$ 是独立的严格正实数；可行集合不附加对称性条件。
+在顶点函数空间上取计数测度内积，定义普通 Laplacian
+
+$$
+(L(c)x)_i=c_i(x_i-x_{i+1})+c_{i-1}(x_i-x_{i-1}).
+$$
+
+令 $H=\{x\in\mathbb R^{12}:\sum_i x_i=0\}$，按重数记特征值为
+$0=\lambda_1(c)<\lambda_2(c)\le\cdots\le\lambda_{12}(c)$。
+以 $L(c)^+$ 表示在 $H$ 上等于 $L(c)|_H$ 的逆、在常数上为零的算子。
+有效电阻与总电阻取为
+
+$$
+R_{\mathrm{eff},c}(i,j)
+=(\delta_i-\delta_j)^{\mathsf T}L(c)^+(\delta_i-\delta_j),
+\qquad
+R(c)=\sum_{0\le i<j\le11}R_{\mathrm{eff},c}(i,j).
+$$
+
+这里 $\delta_i$ 是第 $i$ 个坐标向量，和中共有 $66$ 个无序不同点对。
+这些约定对应 Cruz Ortega–Menéndez-Conde，
+[*Maximal Algebraic Connectivity for Paths with Fixed Effective Resistance*,
+arXiv:2306.08187v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2306.08187v1)，
+§2、§4 定义 4.1–4.2 以及 §5 式 (3)。
+所用经典电学输入是有效电阻的伪逆表达式、
+$R(c)=12\operatorname{tr}L(c)^+$ 与电导缩放律；
+其矩阵形式见 Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi，
+[*Minimizing Effective Resistance of a Graph*](https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/papers/pdf/eff_res.pdf)，
+[DOI:10.1137/050645452](https://doi.org/10.1137/050645452)，
+§§2.4–2.5，式 (8)、(13)–(15)。
+

+**Theorem 8.5 (The supercritical label-square value).** For every integer sequence with $a\to\infty$ and $h/a^{3/2}\to\infty$,
+
+$$
+\frac{M(a,h)}{(a+1+h)^2}\longrightarrow1.
+\tag{8.18}
+$$
+
+**Proof.** For every actual law, the identities (2.3), $K\ge1$ and Cauchy–Schwarz give the elementary lower bound
+
+$$
+H(x)\ge\mathbb E(KU^2)\ge\mathbb E U^2
+       \ge(\mathbb E U)^2=s^2.
+\tag{8.19}
+$$
+
+This uses the same actual marginals and puts no restriction on their positive values or on the cardinality layers. Thus $M(a,h)/s^2\ge1$.
+
+For the matching upper bound put $\rho=h/a^{3/2}$ and choose
+
+$$
+j=\lceil a\rho^{2/5}\rceil.
+$$
+
+Then $j/(a\rho^{2/5})\to1$, $j/a\to\infty$, and
+
+$$
+\frac jh=O\!\left(a^{-1/2}\rho^{-3/5}+h^{-1}\right)\longrightarrow0.
+$$
+
+Consequently $1\le j\le h$ eventually, so (8.3) again is the energy of an actual admissible law. With $m=a+j$ and $n=h+1-j$, one has $m=O(a\rho^{2/5})$, and its core contribution satisfies
+
+$$
+\frac{m^3(m-1)}{(a-1)h^2}
+=O(\rho^{-2/5})\longrightarrow0.
+$$
+
+Its singleton contribution satisfies
+
+$$
+\frac{n^2(m-1)}{jh^2}
+=\left(\frac nh\right)^2\left(1+\frac{a-1}{j}\right)
+\longrightarrow1.
+$$
+
+Here $n/h\to1$, while $s/h=1+(a+1)/h\to1$. Therefore $H_j(a,h)/s^2\to1$, supplying the matching upper bound for the unrestricted infimum. Combining it with (8.19) proves (8.18). ∎
+
+**Open problem 8.6 (Finite values, residual regimes and realizations).** Theorems 8.2, 8.4 and 8.5 resolve the following parts of the diverging-ratio request in Open problem 7.3: the leading surplus for $\sqrt a\ll h\ll a^{3/2}$, the leading value and uniform first correction for $h/a^{3/2}$ in any fixed compact positive interval, and the leading value for $h\gg a^{3/2}$. Theorem 7.2 already determines all fixed positive limits of $h/\sqrt a$. The remaining mathematical questions include:
+
+1. Determine the exact finite values $M(a,h)$, whether they are attained, and any least thresholds for eventual exact formulas.
+2. Classify equality and near-equality laws, and establish quantitative stability in the relevant scales. The necessary residual constraints (8.11)–(8.12) do not establish such a classification or stability theorem.
+3. Obtain sharp uniform estimates when $h/\sqrt a\to0$, and sharper remainders or uniform matching estimates in the moving regimes not specified by (7.20), (8.2), (8.6) or (8.18). In particular, the constant in (8.6) is not asserted to remain bounded when its compact interval approaches $0$ or $\infty$.
+4. Determine which optimizing or asymptotically optimizing laws admit connected finite-graph realizations at prescribed budgets, and the corresponding graph extremal values. The array-law upper bounds above do not impose the graph realization constraints.
+
+The graph normalization remains the one in Definition 1.1 and the Albalahi–Das–Ali–Barman–Hamza source cited after Open problem 7.3. It does not transfer (8.2), (8.6) or (8.18) to graph extrema. The relation of these array-law statements to the Zhao–Zhao article cited there remains undetermined without its full text; no literature-priority assertion is attached to them.
+

+**证明 131.2（定理 128.2）。** 先在同一个实际纤维合成。
+由引理 131.1，
+
+$$
+\log G_y(\alpha)=\alpha c_0+|H|\log B+\log Z_L(\alpha)
+                         +\log\mathcal J_\eta(\alpha,y)+e_\alpha(y),
+\tag{131.7}
+$$
+
+其中 $N_p(e)$ 由 (131.1) 控制。
+式 (121.6) 中的模态常数与输出无关，所以
+$\Xi_\alpha(y)=\log G_y(\alpha)-\log G_0(\alpha)$ 精确成立。
+(131.7) 的前三项在此差中精确消去；引理 129.2 支付
+$\log(\mathcal J_\eta/\mathcal J_0)$ 的完整 $p$ 喷射。
+$\mathcal J_0$ 的 Gaussian 归一化同样在输出比中消去，剩下
+$\log(g_\alpha(y)/g_\alpha(0))$。
+推论 129.3 因此给 (128.4)，其中
+$\sqrt\delta=Q^{-1/4}$、$\eta\le C\delta^5$、$1/\delta=\sqrt Q$。
+每一步均在原完整质量或它的同输出比较上进行。
+
+为了明确阶数去权重，任意有限正后验满足
+
+$$
+\kappa_r(y)=(-1)^r\left.\partial_\alpha^r
+                  \log\sum_m(P_x^y(m))^\alpha\right|_1,
+\quad
+\Delta\kappa_r(y)=(-1)^r\partial_\alpha^r\Xi_\alpha(y)\big|_1,
+\quad r\ge2.
+\tag{131.8}
+$$
+
+第一式是惊讶的矩母函数
+$\sum_mP_x^y(m)e^{s[-\log P_x^y(m)]}=\sum_m(P_x^y(m))^{1-s}$；
+第二式用 (122.4) 第一行的精确有限恒等式，其仿射项在 $r\ge2$ 时消失。
+代入 $F$ 的定义，故 (128.5) 左侧至多
+
+$$
+\max_{2\le r\le p}r!\rho^{-r}N_p(F)
+ \le p!\max(1,\rho^{-p})N_p(F).
+\tag{131.9}
+$$
+
+由 (128.1)，
+
+$$
+\log\{p!\max(1,\rho^{-p})\}
+ \le p\log p+p\log\max(1,\rho^{-1})
+ = (1/64+o(1))\log Q\le\tfrac1{32}\log Q.
+\tag{131.10}
+$$
+
+所以第一误差项去权重后至多 $CQ^{-7/32}$。
+其余三项去权重后的对数额外成本为
+$O((p+1)\log[Q(p+2)]+\log Q)=o(\sqrt Q)$。
+$-cQ^4+L+CQ^2$ 仍为负的 $Q^4$ 阶，因为 $L\le lQ^3$。
+三项最终均小于 $Q^{-1/4}$ 的任意固定正倍数。
+因此它们与 $CQ^{-7/32}$ 之和最终小于 $Q^{-1/8}$。
+这给原始未归一化累积量的 (128.5)，并非只给 Taylor 系数误差。
+
+最后使用证明 127.2 的原好事件穷尽。对任意 $\zeta>0$，先固定一个原常数类，
+使其补集概率对 pair、path 及全部确定大小 $q$ 支持的上确界最终小于 $\zeta$。
+在这个同一类上，(128.5) 对全部 $2\le r\le p(Q)$ 同时成立，
+其阈值可依赖该类及原确定噪声序列。对每个固定 $\varepsilon>0$，
+$Q^{-1/8}<\varepsilon$ 最终成立，故 (128.6) 的上极限至多 $\zeta$。
+令 $\zeta\downarrow0$ 即得结论。
+没有对导数阶数另选好事件；原支持置换等变性及紧输出上确界的可测性仍按证明 127.2 使用。
+完整有限系数族 (128.3) 在首项抵消时也不作替换。∎
+

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@ +#### 命题 5.4（用完整输入探针比较两门） + +额外供应校准的最大纠缠探针 +$\lvert \Phi_d\rangle =d^{-1/2}\sum_j\lvert j\rangle \lvert j\rangle$，定义 +$\lvert U\rangle \!\rangle=(U\otimes I)\lvert \Phi_d\rangle$。则 + +$$ +\langle\!\langle V\rvert U\rangle\!\rangle=\frac{\operatorname{Tr} (V^\dagger U)}d, +\qquad +\min_{\theta}\frac{\left\lVert U-e^{i\theta}V\right\rVert _{\mathrm{HS}}^2}{2d} +=1-\frac{|\operatorname{Tr} (V^\dagger U)|}{d}. +$$ + +**证明。** + +第一式展开 $\Phi_d$，得到 $d^{-1}\sum_j\langle j\rvert V^\dagger U\lvert j\rangle$。第二式展开范数平方为 +$2d-2\Re(e^{-i\theta}\operatorname{Tr} (V^\dagger U))$；选择相位使该实部为迹的模。 + +∎ + +这种门比较与纠缠保真度的标准方法相联系 [[11](#ref-nielsen)]，但它增添了辅助载体、校准探针与相干接口。它通过对所有输入方向编码得到迹，没有证明任意未知本体种子都能直接约去。 + + +

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@ +#### 引理 5.1（精确平衡交换子） + +对 $\Delta\in\operatorname{SU}(2)$，令 $d=\left\lVert \Delta-I\right\rVert_{\rm op}$。存在 $V,W\in\operatorname{SU}(2)$ 使 + +$$ +\Delta=[V,W]_{\rm g},\qquad +\left\lVert V-I\right\rVert_{\rm op},\left\lVert W-I\right\rVert_{\rm op}\le\sqrt d. +$$ + +**证明。** + +$0\le d\le2$。取 $\alpha\in[0,\pi/2]$ 满足 +$\sin^2\alpha=d/2$，置 $V_0=e^{i\alpha X}$、$W_0=e^{i\alpha Y}$。 +由 Pauli 乘法 $XY=iZ$ 及循环关系直接展开有 + +$$ +\operatorname{Tr}[V_0,W_0]_{\rm g}=2-4\sin^4\alpha=2-d^2. +$$ + +$\Delta$ 的特征值 $e^{\pm i\theta}$ 给 $d^2=2-2\cos\theta$，故 $\operatorname{Tr}\Delta=2-d^2$。$\operatorname{SU}(2)$ 中同迹矩阵有相同特征值，彼此酉共轭；共轭矩阵可乘标量使行列式为一。用同一个共轭变换 $V_0,W_0$ 得到 $V,W$，交换子即为 $\Delta$。最后 + +$$ +\left\lVert V-I\right\rVert_{\rm op}^2 +=2-2\sqrt{1-d/2} +=\frac{d}{1+\sqrt{1-d/2}}\le d, +$$ + +对 $W$ 同理。$d=0$ 可直接取 $V=W=I$。 + +∎ + + +
